Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.

Exact current state: Storm effect is possible, not every flood identical; no humans in floodwater.
